description: Get retained county assessment observations and source provenance for a supported address or parcel ID. Missing facts stay unavailable; commercial source area is not finished living area. Any comparison is a draft with evidence holds and does not establish personal tax savings or filing readiness. For a property audit or a request to find tax-reduction routes, review opportunity_screen before concluding. A weak or held comparable-property analysis does not rule out independent relief, record corrections or billing research. Ask the next relevant unanswered targeted_questions item one at a time; use available_questions for relevant follow-ups. Accept none, not sure or skip, and do not repeat answered or skipped questions in this conversation unless the user changes the facts. After an answer, call recheck_property_opportunities for the same selected property and county with the accumulated explicit owner_answers and skipped_question_ids. Rechecks are stateless: resend still-applicable prior answers, preserve explicit false and empty arrays, and omit unknown or skipped fields instead of sending null or inventing a negative answer. Resend stable skipped_question_ids until the user supplies an answer or asks to revisit the question. Skips suppress prompts only and leave requirements unresolved. Do not transfer property-specific answers or skips to another property. When the user is done or skips the remaining questions, summarize supported research routes and missing evidence without treating unknowns as a denial. For a fact-only lookup, answer the requested fact and offer relevant screening without requiring an unrelated intake. Owner answers do not verify eligibility, savings, authority, payment or filing readiness.

actual_sqft.description: Optional: Actual measured living area in sq ft

address.description: Alternative alias for property street address

address_or_pidn.description: Full street address or county parcel ID (e.g. '3731 Anderson Ave, Chattanooga, TN' or '157I L 001')

county_key.description: Optional exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton. Restricts lookup to that county and avoids unrelated county scans; conflicting explicit prefixes are rejected.

notice_appraised_value.description: Optional: New proposed appraised value from reassessment notice

name: get_property_assessment
